notes: Build up to 4 @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ to pressure, 2@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Age up with 4@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_mongols/deer-stones.webp@ then to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 6
Upgrade @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@, build @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ to keep up pressure

description:
As basic as possible Mongol build order for new players. Video below!

The goal is to be aggressive right from the Dark Age with a tower rush into mass Keshik and Archer. Alternatively, you can start with a fast pasture rather than tower rushing - check out the below video for more detail on the variations.

On the whole the Mongols have less of a refined build order as the game is a bit more chaotic with the impact of different spawns + dark age aggression. Think of this as more of a guideline for what you're trying to achieve than a strict build! Again, see the video for details.

Good luck!
name: New Player Guide to Mongols - Trigger/Action Version
author: Elforde

notes: Préparer 6@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ dans groupe de controle pour Age Up

Add @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ when able and research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@+@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@. Slowly add @building_mongols/pasture.webp@ while being aggressive.
TC and Ger near Wood, 5 Vills to Wood 1 Builds Ovoo then Sheep
Once 150 Wood, build Barracks and Produce 2 or 3 Spearman to take one Villager to the enemy base and build Towers
Slowly add Gold Villagers but make sure to have enough Wood (2nd Barracks) and Food for Villagers

description: This guide is based on Valdy's videos. All credits go to him. I just made one that is easier to follow for new players and for me.

notes: @unit_mongols/khan-1.webp@ pop maneuveur, TC @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@, 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ then to @resource/sheep.webp@.

@resource/rally.webp@ 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, use @building_mongols/ger.webp@ to drop off if far from @building_economy/town-center.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@.

@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_mongols/deer-stones.webp@ with 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@, leave only 4@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on sheep, send the rest @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Remember to drop off @resource/sheep.webp@ with @unit_mongols/khan-1.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Shift que the 2 @abilities/repair.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@to sheep.

All @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ drop off @resource/resource_wood.webp@ at @building_economy/town-center.webp@, and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/town-center.webp@ right next to your first one.

Move 8@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ , the rest on @resource/resource_food.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@.
Double produce with @resource/resource_stone.webp@ 4 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@. Shift que on nearby @resource/deer.webp@.
Remacro to wood, if facing feudal aggression, build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@.

Move @landmark_mongols/steppe-redoubt.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, double produce @unit_mongols/shaman.webp@ with @resource/resource_stone.webp@, research @technology_mongols/superior-mobility.webp@ (improved, not the normal one). Get @resource/relics.webp@.

2 @building_economy/town-center.webp@ rally on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, build @building_mongols/pasture.webp@, double produce @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, get eco techs, @abilities/repair.webp@@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@, get mill techs.
@landmark_mongols/deer-stones.webp@ done; pull those 3 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ on @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@.
Pull @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and resume @resource/sheep.webp@ after.
Make 2 more @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ if needed with stone
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.webp@ When enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and @technology_defensive/springald-emplacement.webp@ on ones that are central
If getting raided upgraded @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ for bonus @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ damage
